witnesses.description: A list item's children are `text` tokens carrying their inline tokens in `.tokens`, and marked-terminal's Renderer.prototype.text (index.js:84-89) discards `.tokens` and returns `token.text` -- the markdown source -- through `this.o.text`, which is `identity` (index.js:47). Its heading (:116-119), paragraph (:201-211) and tablecell (:260-265) all call `parser.parseInline(token.tokens)` instead. So `**bold**`, `_em_`, `` `code` ``, `[label](url)` and `~~struck~~` reached the terminal as literal syntax in tight, loose, nested, ordered and task list items, and only there: paragraph, heading, blockquote, table cell, and even a blockquote nested inside a list item all parsed correctly. Loose items are included because marked's Parser.parse `text` case (marked/lib/marked.cjs:1976-1994) builds the loose body from renderer.text before wrapping it in a synthesised paragraph token whose sole child text token has no `tokens` of its own, leaving paragraph's parseInline nothing to parse.
witnesses.fix: src/render.ts's `renderer.text` override (`wrappedText`) dispatches the item's inline tokens itself -- `this.parser.parseInline(token.tokens)` -- with `inlineDepth` raised for the duration so the recursive text tokens inside strong/em/link/del take the library path, and with marked-terminal's HARD_RETURN converted to a real line break (nothing reflows a list item, so that conversion is this seam's to make). Existing guards unchanged: a token with no `tokens`, a body carrying a code SENTINEL, and anything outside a list still return the library's own answer verbatim.
witnesses.fixture_note: Minimal reconstruction, not a vendored file: one item of each kind (tight, loose, ordered, nested, task open/done) plus the interactions the fix has to survive -- an authored soft break that must coalesce, an authored hard break that must not, a reference-style link, a self-referential link, an escaped asterisk, and a fence nested in an item whose `**not bold**` must stay verbatim. Paths are `/home/example` only.

witnesses.revert_note: Proven: with src/render.ts at 8504bd0 and this fixture and describe block in place, `bun test tests/render.test.ts` (pre-WP-R3-split; now `tests/render-list-layout.test.ts`) reports 90 pass / 4 fail. The four that go red are the WP-14 claims -- "every list-item kind renders its inline markup parsed", "a task item's checkbox is rendered once", "an authored hard break still ends its line, and no bare carriage return survives", and "under real ANSI the item is styled like the paragraph". The other three in the block are deliberate scope checks that pass either way, in WP-10's `revert_differentiates: false` sense, and are recorded as such here rather than left to look like part of the proof: the soft-break coalescing is WP-2c's and predates this fix, the fence-verbatim assertion guards a guard that was already there, and the width assertion is a no-regression check on a fixture that never overflowed.
